content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could also be that the compound is known from context? No context given. We may need to request proton NMR to see methyl signals. But we don't have SMILES. The tools require sample at hand; maybe the environment already has a sample loaded. We can call proton_nmr_spectra (no args) to get 1H NMR. Then count methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Let's first get proton NMR.
